title: Handler registry and proof-type build check
description: Generated list of handlers with their authorization proof requirement and a build check result showing no handler lacks it; reflection and unsafe-code analysis results.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Command classification gate results
description: Per build: handlers and their authority-matrix classes; unclassified handlers (must be zero); runtime UnclassifiedCommand refusals.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Object and property authorization test results and denial events
description: Negative tests per endpoint for out-of-scope identifiers and non-permitted fields; production RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND denial events.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Authorization decision records
description: Per consequential decision: principal, command, object, policy version, entitlement version, outcome, reason.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: SoD enforcement records
description: Refused approvals due to SoD with rule version; three-person rule status per sponsor; alternative controls with expiry.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Delegation register and revocation latency
description: Active delegations with scope and expiry; measured time from authority change to enforcement across caches and tokens.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Role-to-command-class matrix for DAF roles
description: Generated matrix of which DAF roles can perform which command classes, demonstrating sponsor-reserved classes are not held by donor, advisor, partner or agent roles.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Generated authorization test suite results
description: Pass and fail results for generated negative and property tests per release, with coverage of command classes and roles.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Independent penetration test summary
description: Summary letter and remediation status from an independent tester covering authorization and tenant isolation.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Agent authority test results
description: Tests that agents cannot invoke reserved or prohibited classes, cannot exceed the delegator, and that injected content cannot add tools.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)

title: Export log
description: Per export: requester, scope, fields, row count, step-up id, approver, recipient.
retention: Not yet defined; to be set with auditor and counsel (SOC2-023)
